title: Sāmaññakāni
html:
• Theragāthā 1.35 Verses of the Senior Monks 1.35
  • Ekakanipāta The Book of the Ones
  • Catutthavagga Chapter Four

Sāmaññakānittheragāthā Sāmaññakāni

“Sukhaṁ sukhattho labhate tadācaraṁ, Seeking happiness, they find it through this practice. Kittiñca pappoti yasassa vaḍḍhati; They get a good reputation and grow in fame, Yo ariyamaṭṭhaṅgikamañjasaṁ ujuṁ, those who develop the direct route: Bhāveti maggaṁ amatassa pattiyā”ti. the noble eightfold path to realize freedom from death.

… Sāmaññakānitthero ….
